description: The SM Series permanent magnet synchronous servo motor is a high-performance motion solution, engineered to pair seamlessly with EURA DRIVES servo drives to form a complete, tightly integrated servo system. Built around high-energy rare-earth permanent magnets, the SM Series delivers exceptional torque density and efficiency in a compact, lightweight frame.

Advanced electromagnetic design minimizes torque ripple and cogging for smooth, stable operation even at low speeds, while the optimized low-inertia rotor provides the fast dynamic response demanded by high-acceleration positioning cycles. High-resolution encoder feedback — available in incremental or absolute versions — ensures precise speed and position control for exacting automation tasks.

With six flange sizes from 40 mm to 180 mm, each offered in standard and holding-brake versions, the SM Series covers a broad spectrum of automation loads. Rugged IP65 construction with shaft oil seal and Class F insulation guarantees a long, reliable service life even in harsh industrial environments.

description: The SD20-E is the third-generation bus-type servo drive, engineered as a high-performance drive with a 3.2 kHz frequency response — more than double the previous generation. Built on a dual-core processor with a hardware current loop, 6 kHz position loop and 16 kHz speed loop, it delivers smooth motor control with no vibration at standstill and precise, fast response across the widest automation tasks.

With built-in EtherCAT (CANopen available as an option), the SD20-E has passed the official EtherCAT Conformance Test (CTT), guaranteeing compatibility with PLCs and automation controllers from different brands. Bidirectional data transmission reaches 100 Mbps with cycle times down to 250 μs, using DC distributed-clock synchronization with sub-microsecond jitter. Feedback options include incremental encoders, absolute encoders up to 23-bit (38 million pulses/rev) and resolvers.

Commissioning is simplified by gain autotuning, inertia autotuning, online rotating inertia identification, model feedforward control and notch filters. Rich functionality includes full-closed-loop control, gantry synchronization, electronic CAM, a built-in PLC for simple user programs, multi-position control, moving fixed-length cutting, gain switching, homing search and vibration suppression — making the SD20-E a complete motion solution.

products.name: SD20-G General-Purpose Servo Drive System
products.tagline: High-response, full-featured servo control from 100 W to 45 kW
products.summary: Fully digital general-purpose servo drive with six control modes, 1.2 kHz response, 1:10,000 speed range, Modbus standard with CANopen/EtherCAT options, and 100 W–45 kW ratings.
description: The SD20-G is a fully digital general-purpose servo drive system designed to drive and control permanent magnet synchronous servo motors. Available in seven compact book-style frames (M1–M7), it covers 100 W to 7.5 kW on 220 V class power (single-phase or three-phase) and 1 kW to 45 kW on three-phase 380 V, making it suitable for everything from small precision axes to large industrial machinery.

Performance is anchored by a 1.2 kHz speed-loop frequency response, a 1:10,000 speed control range and ±0.01% speed fluctuation under 0–100% load. The drive supports all six fundamental control modes — position pulse, internal register position, analog speed, internal register speed, analog torque and internal register torque — plus switchable dual-mode combinations, so one drive can serve positioning, velocity and torque applications. Position commands accept differential or open-collector pulses at up to 500 kHz (4 MHz with high-speed differential input).

The SD20-G is built for easy integration and standalone intelligence: RS485 Modbus communication is standard, with optional CANopen and EtherCAT. An embedded PLC function, high-speed counter, electronic cam, gantry synchronization, full closed-loop control, online/offline inertia identification, auto gain adjustment and vibration suppression simplify commissioning, while a complete protection suite and a 5-digit LED keypad with parameter-copy function round out day-to-day operation.

products.summary: High-performance single-board servo drive, 200 W–1.8 kW, with 4 MHz pulse input, six control modes, Modbus standard and CANopen/EtherCAT options in a 50 mm slim frame.
description: The SDE20-G is a high-performance general-purpose servo drive built on a compact single-board design for driving permanent magnet synchronous servo motors. Operating from single-phase or three-phase 220 VAC, it covers a 200 W – 1.8 kW power range across six models in two slim book-style formats (L2: 177×170×50 mm; L3: 176×180×58 mm), with continuous output currents of 1.5–8.0 Arms.

Engineered for demanding precision motion, the SDE20-G delivers a 1.2 kHz speed response frequency, ±0.01% speed fluctuation across 0–100% load, a 1:10,000 speed control range and 1-command-unit positioning accuracy. It accepts high-speed pulse commands up to 4 MHz and offers six control modes — pulse position, register position, analog speed, register speed, analog torque and register torque — combinable in mixed modes for complex motion sequences.

Auto-tuning intelligence — offline/online inertia identification, gain auto-adjustment, vibration suppression, model feedforward and friction compensation — simplifies commissioning, while a built-in PLC function and high-speed counter enable standalone sequence control. Communication is standard Modbus with RS485/RS232 for PC setup and monitoring, with optional CANopen and EtherCAT versions. With 17/23-bit absolute, 23-bit incremental and 17-bit magnetic encoder support, an integrated EMC C3-class filter and compliance with IEC/EN 61800-5-1 and 61800-3, the SDE20-G is a complete servo solution.

description: The SD20-D series is a high-integration dual-axis AC servo drive system that packs two complete servo drive axes into a single compact book-style unit. By sharing one power-stage housing and wiring harness for both axes, it dramatically cuts cabinet space, wiring labor and overall system cost compared with two standalone drives — an ideal motion solution for multi-axis machines where space and cost are tight.

Built on an advanced motor-control algorithm with high-resolution feedback support, the SD20-D delivers a 2.5 kHz speed response, ±0.01% speed fluctuation, precise speed/torque control and smooth low-speed operation. Each axis provides 5 DI + 3 DO programmable I/O, and the drive supports 2500-line incremental, 23-bit incremental and 17/23-bit absolute encoders as well as resolvers, with full-closed-loop control supported.

Available in EtherCAT-type, CANopen-type and pulse-type variants, the SD20-D covers position, speed and torque applications across a broad range of automated machinery. Advanced functions include gantry synchronization, electronic cam, a built-in PLC, high-speed counter, homing search, interrupt fixed-length positioning and auto gain tuning with online inertia identification.

products.tagline: IP67-rated, motor-mounted VFD power for wet, dusty and high-vibration duty
products.summary: Motor-drive integrated inverter with IP66/IP67 protection and 4g vibration resistance, 0.4–11 kW, supporting induction and PMSM motors with pump/fan intelligence.
description: The EM30 is a motor-drive integrated variable frequency drive engineered to mount directly onto the motor it controls, eliminating cabinet installation and long motor cables. Housed in a die-cast aluminum enclosure with anti-fingerprint finish, it delivers IP66/IP67 protection and 4g vibration resistance, making it suitable for humid, dusty and high-vibration environments where conventional drives cannot survive. Its open-type heatsink ensures reliable cooling and easy cleaning, and the fan is pluggable for quick service.

Available from 0.4 kW to 11 kW in three voltage classes, the EM30 supports both induction motors (VVVF and sensorless vector control) and permanent magnet synchronous motors (SVC), with speed and torque control modes. It delivers 150% starting torque at 0.5 Hz, a 1:100 speed range, ±0.5% steady-speed accuracy and a torque response under 20 ms — performance suitable for demanding loads.

Designed around pump and fan applications, it includes built-in PID closed-loop control, dry-run and pressure protection, master-slave water supply control and time-period scheduling. A brake unit is built in, EMC C2/C3 filters are optional, and it carries CE certification. The segment LCD or four-line LCD keypad can be installed in four orientations, with Bluetooth and IP67-dedicated panel options.

products.summary: General-purpose vector inverter covering 0.2–450 kW with V/F and sensorless vector control for induction and PM motors, built-in PID, multi-pump control and Modbus RTU.
description: The E800 Series is a general-purpose vector inverter covering an applicable motor range of 0.2–450 kW across single-phase 220–240 V, three-phase 230 V and three-phase 380–480 V supplies. Combining advanced motor control with a compact footprint, it delivers V/F control and open-loop sensorless vector control for both induction motors and PMSM permanent magnet synchronous motors, producing 150% starting torque at just 0.5 Hz, a 1:100 speed control range and ±0.5% steady-state speed precision.

Built for real-world industrial automation, the E800 offers 15-stage speed control, built-in PID for process closed-loop regulation, auto voltage regulation, DC braking, speed-tracing restart, and dedicated multi-pump control with sleep/wake dormancy for constant-pressure water supply systems. Frequency reference and command channels are fully flexible: keypad, control terminals, analog signals or Modbus RTU over the built-in RS-485 port.

Housed in a compact wall-mounted format — flame-retardant polycarbonate up to 45 kW and powder-coated metal cabinets from 55–450 kW — the drive integrates a removable LED keypad, optional built-in braking unit, optional EMI filter and optional DC choke. Comprehensive protection functions and CE / UL certification make the E800 a dependable choice for continuous industrial duty.

products.name: EP66 High-Protection Inverter (IP66)
products.tagline: IP66-rugged frequency inverter built for dust, water jets and harsh conditions
products.summary: IP66/NEMA 4 wall-mounted inverter, 0.4–90 kW, with V/F and sensorless vector control, standard C3 EMC filter, and space for built-in customer options.
description: The EP66 series is a high-protection-grade frequency inverter built for the harshest environments. With rugged IP66/NEMA 4 construction compliant with EN 60529, the drive is completely dust-tight and fully protected against jets of water and heavy waves — allowing wall-mounted, cabinet-free installation in locations where ordinary inverters cannot survive. A removable cable conduit plate with humidity-barrier vent keeps moisture out, while polycarbonate (≤15 kW) and metal (18.5–90 kW) housings deliver durable, corrosion-resistant performance from 0.4 kW to 90 kW.

At its heart, a DSP-based motor control platform supports V/F control, sensorless vector control and PMSM sensorless vector control in speed or torque modes, delivering 150% starting torque at just 0.5 Hz, a 1:100 speed control range and ±0.5% steady-state speed precision. Intelligent autotuning makes setup quick, and all standard inverter functions are built in — 15-stage speed control, built-in PID, auto voltage regulation, DC braking, speed-track starting and jog control.

Designed for real-world convenience, the EP66 offers space inside the drive for customer options such as a main/emergency switch, start/stop selectors, a potentiometer and a brake resistor, plus an optional built-in bypass switch. A C3-class EMC filter is standard. Smart PC tools support control and troubleshooting, and configurable LCD keypads are remote-mountable via waterproof connector. CE and UL certifications make it ready for the worldwide market.

features.text: 15-stage speed running, auto circulating, built-in PID, AVR, DC braking, speed-track startup, 150%/60 s overload.

features.title: Smart Connectivity & HMI
features.text: RS-485 Modbus (CAN option), remote-mountable 1-/4-line LCD keypads via waterproof connector, smart PC tools.

items.value: Up to 8 multi-function DI (DI1 up to 50 kHz), 2 DO (up to 100 kHz), relay TA/TB/TC

items.label: Communication
items.value: RS-485 Modbus 1200–57600 bps; optional CAN + Modbus (F15)

products.models: Model numbering: EP66-[power mark][S2|T2|T3][I1–I6] + options. Power marks 0004–0900 (0.4–90 kW). Options: U1 CE / U5 CE+UL; AD01–AD04 keypads; G1 master switch; B1 braking; R3 C3 EMC filter (C1 optional). Example: EP66-0007T3I1.
